name: FREE UGC SPINNER!
desc: We had a good run! We closed as announced last month when the last item ran our we would be closing our doors. We hope to return in a year or 2 with an even better version of the game. We had to close due to rising costs and priorities shifting as a studio to help pay our development teams for new bigger projects we are working on, we had a great almost 3 year run with you guys, thank you for all the support!
